implementationPlan.description:
Refusal forwarding and precedence — DoD 1 and rail 3.
EVERY hold, contract, admission, preparation and approval refusal is returned with its EXACT STABLE CODE and the OWNING LAYER, plus ORIGIN/COMPONENT/TARGET where the refusing surface carries them — and COMMITS NO BUSINESS EVENT OR AUTHORITY. Five refusing surfaces, each keeping its own identity: flattening them would make an admission refusal indistinguishable from an approval refusal at every call site downstream.
REFUSAL PRECEDENCE IS TESTED, NOT ASSUMED (DoD 4). Several layers can refuse the same request, and THE FIRST REFUSAL SHORT-CIRCUITS — so a combined case is unattributable. Pin the precedence order explicitly and RUN EACH ARM ALONE.
Never restamp an upstream code with this module's layer. The distinction between "the hold was stale" and "the approval was refused" is the entire diagnostic value of the roster.

- LEDGER / EXPANSION_ADMISSION_HOLD_UNAVAILABLE <- EXPANSION_REQUEST_LEDGER_ABSENT / LEDGER
- ADMISSION / EXPANSION_ADMISSION_PROPOSAL_REFUSED <- EXPANSION_ADMISSION_REQUEST_MALFORMED / REQUEST
- PROJECTION / EXPANSION_ADMISSION_PROJECTION_REFUSED <- EXPANSION_BINDING_OPPORTUNITY_WINNER_MISMATCH / FAIRNESS
- CONTRACT / EXPANSION_ADMISSION_CONTRACT_MISMATCH <- EXPANSION_HOLD_BINDING_MISMATCH / BINDING

implementationPlan.description:
The late-refusal unwind — DoD 2, the hardest clause and the one most easily faked.
A LATE reservation or resource refusal — one arriving after budget has been reserved — must PROVE BUDGET UNWIND with a NON-EMPTY, EXACT RESTORED-METER SET. Both qualifiers carry weight: an assertion that "unwind happened", or that "some meters were restored", passes unchanged when nothing was restored at all. Assert the SET and its CARDINALITY.
AND IT MUST LEAVE NO DURABLE AUTHORITY OF SEVEN KINDS: resource, child, run, lease, effect, graph mutation, or activation. Assert each INDEPENDENTLY — a single combined "no residue" check can pass while one category leaked, and these are exactly the authorities that cannot be compensated after the fact.
MUTATION-CHECK THE REAL UNWIND, NOT A TEST-OWNED HELPER (DoD 4). A drill against a helper that reimplements the restore grades the helper, not production — the same class of defect as asserting a property against a test double.
Compose the landed budget seam rather than reimplementing unwind: the daemon already reserves and releases through budget-ledger-holds.ts, and activation-budget-stage.ts:222's `captureBudgetLeg` is the precedent for a budget operation riding a decision rather than committing independently.
